component.name: LiquidMon
component.summary: COSMIC panel applet for AIO liquid cooler temps and fan/pump duties via liquidctl

description.p: LiquidMon is a COSMIC panel applet that monitors AIO liquid cooler temperature, fan duty, and pump duty through the liquidctl command-line tool.
It shows live readings in the panel and opens a popup with sparklines, per-fan status, device selection, and a configurable sample interval.

Reliability and accuracy fixes: readings now reflect the true polling cadence and recover from transient device-enumeration failures, liquidctl status parsing and error reporting are more robust, and sparklines handle out-of-range and non-finite samples cleanly. The udev-rules installer now pins the liquidctl rules to a tagged release for reproducible setup.
Popup now shows VU-meter equalizer charts for coolant temperature, pump duty, and fan duty. Animated fan and pump glyphs in popup headers. Panel button retains the gradient sparkline trend glyph.
Configurable sample interval (1–10 s slider, persisted via cosmic-config). Auto-detected device selection with persistent override dropdown.
Initial release. Panel button with live temperature, sparkline, fan duty, and pump duty. Popup with per-metric history and per-fan breakdown.
